We grew up a few mountain ranges and an ocean away, where we too built things with our hands in cramped workshops, dreaming about a place we've seen in films and in well-worn issues of Motocross Action — We’re not from here. your coast, your sunshine, your restless appetite for making something new. You taught the world to surf , , skate , , ride , , chop cars into works of art, and that mixing it all together makes it better. Then you put it all on screen so the rest of us could fall in love from far away. We did. Now we're making this place a home. We want to honor what came before us, and we'll bring the best of where we come from — the American Midwest, Central Europe - along with the motorcycles we’ve spent years building and riding. We have endless respect for the culture you have created, and we’re excited to get involved and contribute something of our own. Thanks for having us. We’re glad to be here. Let’s make some cool things together.
